digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify corpus and external Pandoc replay
propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay in Gerrit Verify contributes a measured 184.32-second macOS overhead by executing the production subprocess path repeatedly over deterministic inputs.

Committed deterministic Pandoc outputs covering 178 bodies and 1,383 ordered conversions enable broad corpus assertions in Verify without live subprocess invocation while retaining all behavioral and safety assertions.
Three representative evidence-selected bodies (one each from code_arrow, table, and prose strata) remain as live product-path verification with version/platform/argv/stdin/timeout probes.
Full real-Pandoc replay is moved to a dedicated external integration job with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix arms on weekly schedule and manual dispatch.
Paired same-host A/B testing demonstrates 90.8% wall-time reduction (42s baseline to 4s implementation) in the focused Pandoc phase by moving replay from hot path to external job.
